description: Clean Markdown of a single chapter - the recommended way to put Cyber Library text into an agent context. Chapter 0/1 are both accepted for the opening chapter. When to use: after cyberlibrary_get_toc, to read the specific chapter you care about without pulling the whole book. Do not use: to read an entire book in one shot (use cyberlibrary_get_markdown, but mind the size). Returns: {chapter, title, chars_total, chars_returned, truncated, markdown, markdown_url}.

max_chars.description: Truncate Markdown to this many characters (1000-100000). Default 20000.

name: cyberlibrary_get_chapter
title: Cyberlibrary Get Chapter
